entities.summary: Gerald Rashard Everett is an American professional football tight end. He played college football for the Bethune–Cookman Wildcats, Hutchinson Blue Dragons, UAB Blazers, and South Alabama Jaguars, and was selected by the Los Angeles Rams in the second round of the 2017 NFL draft. He has also played for the Seattle Seahawks, Los Angeles Chargers, and Chicago Bears.
